description.raw: Kruger launches a mighty slash to knock down an enemy for 1.5s, dealing 450% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage and inflicting them with 3 stacks of Shatter Armor. Each stack reduces the target's Phys DEF by 10%, up to 4 stacks on a target.
active: Kruger launches a mighty slash to knock down an enemy for 1.5s, dealing 450% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage and inflicting them with 3 stacks of Shatter Armor.
Each stack reduces the target's Phys DEF by 10%, up to 4 stacks on a target.

text: Unlocks at level 51: If Kruger is present, the ally inflicts enemies with an extra stack of Shatter Armor when reducing their Phys DEF.

Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 500% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based).

description.raw: Kruger launches a powerful attack on adjacent enemies with at least 4 stacks of Shatter Armor and not affected by Vulnerable, dealing 400% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage and inflicting Vulnerable. For Vulnerable enemies, their physical damage taken is increased by 40%, and 40% of their damage taken in transformed to Kruger's HP.

description.raw: When a battle starts, Kruger gains a shield that blocks damage equal to 40% (HP-based) for 15s if no allies are present within the surrounding 1 tile. The shield also grants him control immunity. Additionally, Kruger gains 30 Life Drain when no allies are detected within the surrounding 1 tile.
active: When a battle starts, Kruger gains a shield that blocks damage equal to 40% (HP-based) for 15s if no allies are present within the surrounding 1 tile.
The shield also grants him control immunity.
Additionally, Kruger gains 30 Life Drain when no allies are detected within the surrounding 1 tile.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Increases the shield value to 44% (HP-based).
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Removes the distance limit for Vital Strike (the other restrictions remain).
Kruger can rush to Vulnerable enemies and cast Vital Strike to deal damage.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Increases the shield value to 48% (HP-based).

description.raw: Kruger gains a 40% ATK boost until the battle ends when a Vulnerable enemy is defeated by Vital Strike, stacking up to 2 stacks.
active: Kruger gains a 40% ATK boost until the battle ends when a Vulnerable enemy is defeated by Vital Strike, stacking up to 2 stacks.
